initialization: fresh same-seed models, no G1 checkpoint or CE pilot
sampling: uniform whole training sentences with replacement, generator seed 30000+student seed; state reset per sentence
selection: final fixed-budget checkpoint; no early stopping or hyperparameter search
compute: equal sampled sentences, bytes and updates across student conditions within each seed; runtime measured separately
test_policy: evaluate only after every scheduled model has finished training; no test-based reruns or selection
